items.desc: The Rs92.67 billion hydropower project will use water discharged from the 900MW Arun-3 plant to generate electricity, but financial closure is still pending.

items.title: Shah, Modi lay foundation stone for Siliguri-Jhapa oil pipeline
items.desc: The Rs11.14 billion project also includes a new petroleum storage terminal in Jhapa, with a capacity of 18,900 kilolitres, funded entirely by India.

items.title: Shah invites Modi to visit Nepal, welcomes Indian investors
items.desc: At a joint press conference in New Delhi, Nepal’s prime minister says the two countries have embarked on a development partnership as they launch the Ayodhya-Janakpur train service.

items.title: Nepal and India sign eight MoUs on cooperation in multiple sectors
items.desc: Agreements cover forensic science, police training, civil service capacity building, satellite communications, health, urban development and traditional medicine.

items.title: Shah and Modi inaugurate bridge, flag off Janakpur-Ayodhya train
items.desc: The two leaders inaugurate a motorable bridge linking Darchula with India and the second phase of a petroleum pipeline, and lay foundation stones for an integrated check post, oil terminal and hydropower project.

items.title: Shah-Modi bilateral talks conclude in New Delhi

items.title: Parsa National Park to build two more waterholes for wildlife
